data.body:
Patchset 2 pushed to change 2619 (commit 7f442c3336cd, same Change-Id — one change, not a
duplicate).

Patchset 1 got LLM-Review +1 (PASS) with one advisory, which I acted on rather than waved
through, because it was a correct catch on this bug's own subject matter: my docs/coverage.md
sentence said `make test` and the documented coverage invocation 'no longer differ', but
`make test` carries no --cov flags, so they still do. A doc overstating agreement between a
local command and the real one is precisely the defect class this ticket exists to fix, so
letting it stand would have been ironic in the worst way. Reworded to claim only what is
true: the SCHEDULER no longer has to be added by hand, and the coverage invocation is still
the one to use when you want the report.

Amending removed the +1, as expected; both bots re-run on PS2.
